human_authority_instructions.purpose: Populate only with values explicitly approved by Human Authority. This template is intentionally non-executable until every required value is supplied and status is changed to AUTHORIZED with a Canon approval reference.
human_authority_instructions.authorityRef: Set to the immutable Canon approval identifier for this exact policy envelope.
human_authority_instructions.allowedProviders: List only providers explicitly approved for autonomous submission. Provider policy and connector capability still override this allowlist.
human_authority_instructions.minimumCompensationCents: Set the minimum guaranteed or otherwise policy-approved compensation in integer cents.
human_authority_instructions.maximumApplicationCostCents: Set the maximum per-application financial commitment in integer cents. Zero forbids paid applications.
human_authority_instructions.dailySubmissionLimit: Set the total maximum autonomous submissions per day.
human_authority_instructions.perPlatformDailyLimit: Set the maximum autonomous submissions per provider per day.
human_authority_instructions.activation: After review, set status to AUTHORIZED and enabled to true. Never reuse an authorityRef after changing any material threshold or provider rule.
